knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The SMART option names a measure, a threshold, a scope and a deadline. The others are vague or have no measure.
A milestone shows early progress so the lead can correct course before the final deadline. It does not replace the deadline or the owner.
A goal that rewards speed when it undercuts the standard must be changed, and the reason recorded. Hiding checks or removing deadlines do not fix the problem.

practicalCriteria: The learner rewrites a supplied vague crew goal so that it names the result, a measure, a deadline and at least two dated milestones with owners.
The learner completes the five-point SMART check and corrects any failing word.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Milestone record with owners and dates
stopWorkCriteria: Stop and refer any goal that would require a worker to skip a safety step or a site rule.
Stop and refer any goal that depends on work outside the crew's trained tasks.
